title: bodhavilasa — bodh-p04-v39
question: There-that sporting yogi, in mantra-lord-status situated — there capable lord, as plays power-expanded.
issue: Derived from L2 text (no argmap). There-that sporting yogi, in mantra-lord-status situated — there capable lord, as plays power-expanded.

premises.text: madhyadhāmavikāse tu upāyo balavatsthitiḥ vikalpakṣayasaṅkocavikāsādyā anekaśaḥ akiñciccintanād eva vikalpānāṃ kṣayo bhavet cidbodhād vilasacchaktī raktāsau bhāvamaṇḍale tatrānuraktā divyaughaṃ paśyate vimalātmakam śaktisaṅkocam etad dhi procyate brahmavādibhiḥ ādyantakoṭiviśrāmabindunādalayās tathā aśaṅkitabhayakrodhabībhatsādiparigrahāḥ ity etat kathitaṃ devi madhyadhāmavikāsakam tatra śakto dinair evaṃ prapnoti parasampadam yo 'ntaḥsamādhisaṃskāraṃ bhramate vimalatviṣām sa visargabalād eva vimṛśya ca punaḥ punaḥ vyutthāne 'pi yatas tasya svarūpaṃ samprakāśate yogino bodhaniṣṭhasya nityānandarasasya ca tat prakāśānandamayī mantravīryopabṛṃhitā pūṛnāhantācid ity antaḥsamullāsābhiyoginaḥ tatrāsau vilasan yogī mantreśvarapade sthitaḥ tatra śakto vibhur yadvat krīḍate śaktibṛṃhitaḥ evaṃ svatantratā tasya vyāpakasya jagadvibhoḥ nānābhedajuṣaś citrapadasthitasyākhaṇḍitā
